description: This file defines the CookieMonster class, a core component for storing and managing cookies within the Chromium project. It includes data structures, constants, and method declarations for cookie management, garbage collection, and interaction with persistent storage.

classes.name: net::CookieMonster
classes.description: Main class responsible for storing, retrieving, and managing cookies, including garbage collection and interaction with persistent storage.

classes.name: net::CookieMonster::PersistentCookieStore
classes.description: Abstract interface for persistent cookie storage, supporting load, add, update, delete, and flush operations.

methods.name: SetAllCookiesAsync
methods.description: Replaces all cookies in the store with the provided list, without flushing to backend.

methods.name: SetCanonicalCookieAsync
methods.description: Sets a canonical cookie asynchronously, considering source URL, options, and access results.

methods.name: GetCookieListWithOptionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cookies matching URL, options, and partition keys asynchronously.

methods.name: FlushStore
methods.description: Flushes in-memory cookies to persistent storage asynchronously.
